confidenceNotice: League-reported season totals, not individually verified game attendance or lineup confirmation. Earlier same-ID observations can include different teams in one season and are not additive by default. Player stats may be incomplete or corrected later. Special teams abbreviations PPG and PPA mean power-play goals and assists, not points per game. No opponent win probability.
